notes.title: Steam Achievements is here!
notes.content:

Here are the patch notes (1.033.821):
NEW CONTENT

ADDED 40 Steam Achievements
Performance improvements to all areas of the game
Optimized and improved load order for faster load
Minor tweaks to channel hype gain and promotion bonus
Tweaks to income from VIP subscriptions
Tweaks to income from stream donations
Tweaks to increase project quality for staff (all professions)
Numerous minor bug/grammar/graphics fixes
Numerous of minor other balance changes
Updated several tooltips
Savefiles from previous version are compatible

notes.title: New Game from Please Subscribe Devs!
notes.content:
This is Tower Walker! In this new Autobattler RPG game from Raptor Claw Games, the developers that made "Please Subscribe", you create your character and join an expedition to explore and discover an ancient old tower in the northern lands. Watch the Teaser Trailer here:

[previewyoutube=CyUcK6CE7-k;full][/previewyoutube]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CyUcK6CE7-k
FEATURES

 GRIND
 LOOT
 CRAFT
 UPGRADE
 MANAGE
 TRADE
 ENCHANT
 EXPLORE
 CONQUER

Tower Walker is releasing on Steam in two weeks. February 8th, 2023. WISHLIST NOW: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2130060/Tower_Walker_MMO_Grind_Simulator/

notes.title: 4 WEEKS LEFT TO LAUNCH...
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41546928/e6e7db5f04ebc860fc8d757278cc545d4e2cc293.png

Hey there! Today is a good day to get hyped for our next tycoon game that is arriving to Steam on February 10th! 

The last few weeks has been amazing, the number of wishlists has proved this sequel to be a massive success and a milestone for us even before launch. A year ago we had a "dreams" list of things we wanted to do to in this project based on what we learned from Gamer Career Tycoon. We can proudly announce that every single one of those new things are now in the game. We have put a great amount of effort into major additions to the progression and character choices, we also added some truly cool stuff and improvements to the game world and how it interacts with you. And then of course we have the new isometric style graphics that we believe suits the game very well.

PREPARING FOR RELEASE
We are currently hard at work refining and polishing to get ready for launch. We cant wait to share the game with you. Thanks again everyone for your support, following and wishlisting the game. Every bit helps out. We are very happy to see that so many of you are looking forward to the launch, we are, after all, making this game for you.

Pricing
Digital download on Steam available February 10th, 2022
$9.99 with a 15% launch discount
